system.description: A translucent, indestructible wall, 10' by 10', stands where you point within 60'. Nothing passes through it, not even light, and the wall remembers whoever touched it last. Sustained.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and the wall may be up to 20' by 10'.
outcomes.success: The wall stands while you sustain it. Summoned through a foe, it deals 2d8 damage and shoves the foe to a side of your choice.
outcomes.failure: The wall stands only until the end of your next turn, and a foe it passes through takes half damage.
outcomes.ruin: The wall closes around you instead: you are Restrained until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.

outcomeEffects.note: a 10' by 10' wall (up to 20' by 10' on a Triumph) stands while you sustain it; through a foe it deals the damage and shoves it aside; on a Failure it stands only until the end of your next turn
